user_text: My 3-phase induction motor on a conveyor drive trips the thermal overload after about 20 minutes of no-load running. The winding resistance is balanced across phases and the supply voltage is stable at 400V. I need a mechanism that explains why it still overheats on no-load, and what would disprove it.
